svg.title: Card ranking in this version
svg.desc: Two rows of hearts, from highest to lowest. Normal order: ace, King, Queen, Jack, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2. Ace and 7 on top option: ace, 7, King, Queen, Jack, 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2.
svg.text: The suit does not change the value: the ace of hearts and the ace of clubs are worth the same. With 52 cards,
the 10, 9 and 8 go between the Jack and the 7 in the normal order, and between the Jack and the 6 with ace and 7 on top.
